info.title: SP Trading API
info.description:
Machine interface of SP Wallet: market data, portfolio, positions, orders, strategies and agents.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer spw_live_…` (an API key created by the owner with his passkey). A key opens nothing outside `/api/v1/trading/`.

Every operation names the scope it needs (`x-spw-scope`). Scopes are access control inside the API; they are not what bounds execution: an order placed with a key is bounded by a trading mandate that the isolated signer enforces, and execution scopes are inert without one.

Numbers that carry money are decimal strings. Paper and live data always carry a `mode` and are never merged.

Errors are `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<sentence>" }`. Rate limits are per key: `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` (seconds).

get.summary: Compare the estimated cost of one position across venues
get.description: One row per venue for a common underlying, from the real instrument, order book (GMX: pool figures), ticker, fee schedule and funding rate read now: spread, depth within 10/25/50 bps, slippage for the notional, fees, funding expected over the horizon (current rate held constant), collateral, liquidation estimate and the itemised total. Every figure is an estimate; a missing input gives null with its reason. Venues the wallet cannot trade on are shown and flagged. `discrepancies` are estimates with their assumptions and risks, never a recommendation.

post.description: Idempotent on (principal, Idempotency-Key): a replay answers the same order and never sends a second request to a venue. Owner session: the order is checked and waits `AWAITING_APPROVAL` until the owner approves it with the passkey in the app (paper: executed at once, nothing is signed). API key: needs a trading mandate bound to the key that covers the order exactly (403 `mandate_denied` with the reasons otherwise), then the risk engine, then the venue engine's mandate path — the isolated signer applies the derivative mandate it stores. LIVE needs `SPW_TRADING_API_EXECUTION=on` on the server (403 `execution_disabled` otherwise) and the existing mainnet locks. A refusal after the order exists answers 4xx with the order in `data.order` (state `REJECTED` or `FAILED`). An outcome that is not known is `UNKNOWN`, never a failure. Spot orders: 403 `spot_execution_requires_agent_vault` for a key; 422 `spot_via_swap_screen` for the owner.

post.summary: Preview an order: every check it would meet, and an estimate
post.description: Resolves the instrument and the account, then runs the key limits, the server locks, the trading mandate (keys and agents), the independent risk engine and the venue engine's own checks on the market as it is now. Answers the canonical order and its hash, every check with what was observed and its limit, an estimate (fees, slippage against the real book, liquidation price) and whether an owner passkey approval would be required. Never creates, signs or sends anything.

post.summary: Run one line of the trading command grammar
post.description: Deterministic grammar (no model). The scope checked is the one of the operation the command resolves to: an order needs `orders:execute` (`orders:prepare` with `dryRun`), CLOSE `positions:manage`, CANCEL `orders:cancel`, SHOW the matching read scope, KILL `positions:manage`. Resolution uses the owner's stored defaults (GET/PUT /api/v1/developer/command-defaults) and nothing else: a command the defaults do not settle answers 409 `ambiguous_command` with the questions and executes nothing.

501.description: `execution_not_wired`: this operation is declared but not connected yet. Never a success.

post.description: Not wired in this version: the call is authenticated, authorized, validated and checked for replay, then answers 501 `execution_not_wired`. It never answers 2xx.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay protection: 8 to 100 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key with the same request returns the first answer; with a different request, 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

parameters.name: X-SPW-Timestamp
parameters.description: Optional freshness check: Unix seconds; refused (400 `stale_request`) when more than 300 s from the server clock.

401.description: `unauthenticated`: missing, malformed, unknown, expired or revoked key

501.description: `execution_not_wired`: this operation is declared but not connected yet. Never a success.

bearerKey.description: API key shown once at creation. Never sent together with a session cookie.

x-spw-webhook-events.description: an API key was revoked (or replaced by a rotation)
the emergency halt of the signer was triggered (source "signer"), or the global kill switch of the risk engine was engaged or released (source "risk_engine")
x-spw-webhook-events.payload: { source: "signer", halted: true } | { source: "risk_engine", engaged, by, reason }

x-spw-webhook-events.description: an agent changed mode through an owner action (engine-side transitions: pending wiring)
an order changed state: one event per transition of the unified order state machine, for every principal, mode and venue
x-spw-webhook-events.payload: { orderId, mode, venue, instrument, status, previous, event, reason, seq, principal, mandateId }
